critical_code_review_comments: Stale-bundle false alarm during initial run: Expo Metro is started with CI=true (see /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log -> 'Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled'). Hot-reload is therefore disabled and a manual `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` was required to pick up the iter-331 edit before the new layout actually rendered. This will likely bite future iterations. RECOMMEND: either drop CI=true from the expo supervisor env or document that the main agent must trigger an expo restart after every frontend edit.

/app/frontend/app/procedures/[id].tsx is 5178 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Repeated edits to this file (iter-329, 331) keep amplifying review effort and accidental drift between sections. Strongly recommend splitting into per-section components (e.g., ProcedureTypeSection, TreatmentProgressSection, BottomActionBar).

RN-Web does NOT serialize the `data-testid` prop on plain <View> elements — only TouchableOpacity/Text render it via testID. The 'procedure-type-section' attribute we set on the parent View was therefore not present in the DOM, making the section non-queryable from Playwright. To make this asserttion-friendly, either move the data-testid to a child Touchable OR add a matching testID prop on the View (RN-Web maps testID -> data-testid on the rendered div for TouchableOpacity/Text but not always for View). Not a functional bug, just a testability nit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) Expo is in CI mode (no hot reload) — after any frontend edit run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` then curl the public URL once to trigger Metro to rebundle (~7s) before opening Playwright. Otherwise you will be testing a STALE bundle and see iter-330 behaviour. (2) Use soft navigation: history.pushState + window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')). page.goto() destroys the in-memory auth token on Expo Web. (3) Login button text is literally 'Login' (use page.get_by_text('Login', exact=True).click(force=True)). Login lives at the root path '/', NOT '/login' (/login → 'Unmatched Route'). (4) For DOM-walked element-by-text lookups in RN-Web, prefer document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT) — naive querySelector('[textContent=...]') and `el.children.length === 0` filters fail because RN-Web nests Text inside multiple wrapper divs. (5) procedure-type-section data-testid is NOT in the DOM (RN-Web View limitation) — use the layout/spatial assertion via parentElement of the matching text node instead.
rca of the issue: No bug. The iter-331 layout move was implemented correctly in a single contiguous block at /app/frontend/app/procedures/[id].tsx lines 1800-1859 — the original bottom-bar TouchableOpacity is gone (only one grep hit on 'PRE-OP BRIEFING' in the whole codebase), and the bottom-bar render gate at line 3932 is correctly reverted to (canExportPDF() || canViewAiSummary()). Approved Sinus Lift case in screenshot shows: green PRE-OP BRIEFING pill inline right of 'Procedure Details' title, and EXPORT/PRINT + AI SUMMARY two-button bottom bar properly spaced (no longer cramped). Initial scary-looking 'btnInAbsolutePositionedAncestor=true' detection was a Playwright-side false-positive caused by ANY RN-Web ScrollView wrapper higher up the chain reporting position:absolute — confirmed false-positive because the button rect (y=1337) is in the middle of the page next to the title (y=1337, y-diff=6px), NOT at the bottom-bar y=3961 position which it would have occupied if the gate had failed. Layout assertion x=1023 > title-right=892 confirms right-alignment in same row.
